reason: S1 exposes the new public entry point spng_decode_chunks(), but H0 never calls it. The function has its own state-sensitive protocol—rejecting encode-only contexts, contexts before SPNG_STATE_INPUT, accepting SPNG_STATE_IEND, and otherwise invoking read_chunks(ctx, 0)—that is not exercised through this API by the existing image-decoding workflow.
evidence: spng_decode_chunks() branches on ctx == NULL, ctx->encode_only, ctx->state < SPNG_STATE_INPUT, and ctx->state == SPNG_STATE_IEND before calling read_chunks(ctx, 0).
tests/spng_read_fuzzer.c calls spng_decoded_image_size(), chunk getters, spng_decode_image(), spng_decode_row(), and spng_get_row_info(), but contains no call to spng_decode_chunks().
H0 always creates a decode context and sets a PNG buffer, stream, or file before parsing, so it does not test the new API's no-source or alternate-state call protocol.
recommended_action: Add a fuzz-controlled spng_decode_chunks() route that invokes it across buffer and stream inputs, before source assignment, after source assignment, repeatedly after successful or failed chunk parsing, and after reaching IEND; check stable return behavior and sanitizer findings.
